description: This Java interface defines the HonoConnection for managing AMQP 1.0 connections, including creation of senders and receivers, connection lifecycle, and support for capabilities within the Eclipse Hono client framework.

classes.name: HonoConnection
classes.description: Interface for managing AMQP connections, creating links, and handling connection lifecycle within the Eclipse Hono client.

methods.name: newConnection
methods.description: Creates a new HonoConnection instance with specified Vertx and client configuration properties.

methods.name: getVertx
methods.description: Returns the Vertx instance used by this connection.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Returns the OpenTracing Tracer used for distributed tracing.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the client configuration properties used for this connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the AMQP connection with default options, returning a Future that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the AMQP connection with specified ProtonClientOptions.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Re-establishes connection to the server, allowing reconnects after disconnection.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the connection, waiting up to 5 seconds for proper closure.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the connection with a completion handler.

methods.name: isShutdown
methods.description: Checks if the connection is already shut down or in the process of shutting down.

methods.name: getRemoteContainer
methods.description: Returns the remote container ID as advertised by the peer.

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.description: Checks if the client supports a specific AMQP capability.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes code on the Vertx context used for the connection, returning a Future with the result.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an AMQP sender link to a target address with specified QoS and remote close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates an AMQP receiver link with specified source address, QoS, message handler, and remote close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates an AMQP receiver with prefetch size.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates an AMQP receiver with prefetch size and auto-accept option.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes an AMQP link and frees resources, with default timeout.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes an AMQP link with a specified timeout and frees resources.
